actions.action: Tug bare stems and check base for mushiness, blackness or sour smell
Check soil dryness with finger or wooden skewer before watering
Water only when soil is fully dry
Move plants gradually over a week to brightest window
Trim rotten tissue with clean scissors and let plant dry 2-3 days
If soil is soggy, repot into cactus/succulent mix in pot with drainage hole
Take cuttings of healthy stem tips or leaves, callus 2-3 days, set on dry mix
Mist or water cuttings lightly once rooted

reason: The answer's main diagnosis is the confirmed one: too little light plus overwatering. Its core advice to water only when the soil is dry and to move the plants to bright light matches the fix that worked, and it is safeguarded by soil checks, so it is not harmful.
